suites.agent: whole agent runs against a live site or device; complete means the task finished. confounded by the site and harness, see docs/EVALS.md.
suites.jevbench-public: jevbench's 231 public items (easy 48, original 72, hard 111) through verdict's /v1/systemone with jevbench's own typesafe adapter. public items only: the board's sealed items are not run.
suites.option-mass: option mass on an unambiguous verification question at several option counts; below the floor a formatter is refused.
suites.smoke: element selection with ground truth: 16 cases, 4 option counts x 4 positions of the correct answer, fixed distractors.
